answers.core:
While this could be an addon like the `GradientTexture2D` once was, it feels simple enough to be a part of the main Godot engine.
~~you could also probably modify the `ProxyTexture` to do this, I mean who actually uses those~~
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around by combining your textures all into one image, but it would be harder to modify parts of said image, especially if you have to keep track of translucent parts.

Alternatively, you could slap a `NinePatchRect` on top of a `Button` with a `Style` that uses a different texture (such as a `GradientTexture`), but then you have twice as many nodes to take care of.
